subsection.title: Assumptions
subsection.description: List unverified beliefs that influenced the current PoC and what evidence would confirm or challenge them.

subsection.title: Unresolved Decisions
subsection.description: List product choices that remain open, the available directions, and the impact of delaying the decision.

subsection.title: Decisions Required Before PoC
subsection.description: List only unresolved items that would prevent the PoC from being created or evaluated. Write "None" when there are none.
